Name: Abner, Son of Ner
Summary: Abner, son of Ner, commanded Saul's army, made Ish-bosheth king after Saul's death, and then defected to David, bringing the northern tribes with him. Joab murdered him at Hebron in revenge for his brother Asahel, and David publicly mourned him.
KeyStory: Abner held Saul's kingdom together, then handed it to David — and was murdered for an old battlefield debt.
KeyVerses: 1 Samuel 14:50; 1 Samuel 17:55; 1 Samuel 26:5; 2 Samuel 2:8; 2 Samuel 3:27; 1 Kings 2:5; 1 Kings 2:32; 1 Chronicles 26:28
RelatedPeople: King Saul; Ner, Son of Abiel; Ish-bosheth, Son of Saul; Joab; King David; Joab, Son of Zeruiah; Amasa, Son of Jether; Ner, Father of Abner; Ner, Son of Jehiel
LifeLesson: Revenge dressed as justice still murders; David's mourning shows what a kingdom should grieve.
